attestations.text: LIU Tsê-ch'ing 劉澤清 (T. 鶴洲) d. Dec. 9, 1648, renegade Ming general with a reputation for cruelty, hypocrisy, and corruption, was a native of Ts'ao-hsien, Shantung. Starting his career as second captain in a military post in Liaotung, he distinguished himself fighting against the Manchu invaders and by 1633 had attained the rank of brigade-general and three years later, general-in-chief and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
